tools.name: run_delete
tools.title: Delete a run, a load profile or a saved run
tools.description: Delete a run, a load profile or a saved run (kind + item_id). Runs in progress are refused.

item_id.description: The run, load profile or saved run to delete.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: run_get
tools.title: Get one run
tools.description: Get one run: state, configuration, failure stage; include=diagnostics adds the build output.

run_id.description: The run: its handle (e-1a2b3c4d) from run_test or process_get_status, or its UUID; default: the last run of this workspace.

include.description: "diagnostics": why the run stopped or failed, when LoadCraft knows.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: run_get_profiles
tools.title: Get stored load profiles
tools.description: Get stored load profiles: the list, or one with its injection steps.

profile.description: One load profile with its injection steps (name or id); without it, the list.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: run_get_saved
tools.title: Get saved runs with their schedules
tools.description: Get saved runs with their schedules: the list, or one.

saved_run.description: One saved run (name or id); without it, the list.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: run_get_usage
tools.title: Get finished runs over a period and the compute time they used
tools.description: Get finished runs over a period and the compute time they used.

days.description: How many past days of usage to return (1-365).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: run_list
tools.title: List the project's runs, newest first
tools.description: List the project's runs, newest first: status, target, environment; include=results adds headline results.

target.description: Only runs of this scenario or composition (name or id).

include.description: "results": the headline numbers of each run.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: run_save
tools.title: Save a run definition for reuse
tools.description: Save a run definition for reuse (target, load, environment, data bindings; id: update).

saved_run_id.description: The saved run to change; without it, a new one is created.

name.description: The name; required for a new saved run.

scenario_id.description: The scenario a new saved run starts (give this or composition_id; new only).

composition_id.description: The composition a new saved run starts (give this or scenario_id; new only).

environment_id.description: The environment; set or change, never clear.

target_base_url.description: The target address; set or change, never clear.

workload.description: The load {type, vusers, ramp, hold, thresholds}; replaced as a whole.

feeder_bindings.description: Slot -> dataset id; replaced as a whole.

source_execution_id.description: The run this saved run is made from (new only).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: run_save_profile
tools.title: Save a stored load profile
tools.description: Save a stored load profile (users, ramp, duration, default flag; no id: create).

profile.description: The load profile to change (name or id); without it, a new one is created.

name.description: The profile name (needed to create; renames on change).

is_default.description: true: make it the default profile of the project.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.
